assessments.reasoning: Ecma International publishes the controlling ECMA-262 15th-edition algorithm. Fresh direct acquisition returned the exact registered source SHA-256. A null environment returns the unresolvable record. A true HasBinding result creates a reference to the current record. Otherwise the algorithm recurses into [[OuterEnv]]. In ECMAScript 2024, GetIdentifierReference searches an environment chain by calling HasBinding at each visited environment, returns a reference based on the first matching environment, and returns an unresolvable reference if the chain reaches null. The operation runs with a String name and a Boolean strict flag, and every HasBinding call it reaches completes normally. This is the abstract reference-creation algorithm. It does not read an environment binding's value or decide every later use of the returned reference. An exception from HasBinding propagates before recursion. A name lookup that reaches null returns a reference record at this stage, regardless of the strict flag.
